title: Methodology Reference page -- non-blocking review follow-ups
description: Non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #189 (frontend-methodology-explainer), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's autonomous-pipeline rule so they aren't lost once that PR merges.

checklist.step: MethodologyPage.tsx's ALL_STATUSES and MethodologyStatusFilter.tsx's STATUS_ORDER both hand-duplicate the full list of MethodologyStatus values, with no compiler-enforced link between them or to the STATUS_META Record (features/methodology/data/methodologyContent.ts) that already enumerates every status as a typed Record's keys. A future 5th status would get a compiler-enforced STATUS_META entry but silently no compiler error if a contributor forgets to add it to one or both of these plain string[] literals -- entries with the new status would be missing from the default 'select all' state and/or the filter row's chips/legend, uncaught by existing tests (which hardcode only the current 4 labels). Derive both from `Object.keys(STATUS_META) as MethodologyStatus[]` (or export one shared ordered array from methodologyContent.ts) instead.

MethodologyEntryCard.tsx renders `entry.crossLinksTo` as plain descriptive text ('See it live: Stock Detail page -> Signal Summary -> Tide (Screen 1) help icon'), not an actual clickable/navigable link -- a reader has to manually go find that page/panel themselves. The task's recorded decision only committed to 'naming' the location (not linking to it), so this isn't a violation of that decision, but a real in-app link (e.g. a react-router Link to the relevant page, possibly with a query param or anchor the target page reads to auto-open the right MetricHelp popover) would make the cross-link meaningfully more useful than prose alone.

No Playwright e2e spec (frontend/tests/e2e/) covers the new /methodology route, its status filter, or the Stock Detail <-> Methodology cross-link round trip -- this brand-new page currently has zero persisted regression coverage in that suite (only vitest/RTL component tests). Consider adding a methodology.spec.ts alongside the existing dashboard/navigation/portfolio/watchlist/stock-analysis specs.
